name: VS Code (Copilot)
note: Chat lives per workspace: workspaceStorage/<hash>/chatSessions/<id>.jsonl, with the folder in a sibling workspace.json as a file:// URI. The whole conversation is one record, so the numbers come from its requests array — tokens, Copilot credits and the model are per request and are summed. Copilot's global session-store.db looked like the right source but records only some conversations and reported the wrong project. VS Code is one process for every window, so this is one row: the workspace worked on most recently.
